Title: Top Iranian official injured in strike on Tehran – as it happened
Date: 2026-04-02

Content: (If you’ve ever watched one of Trump’s cabinet meetings then you know the vibe). According to semi-official Mehr news agency, Kamal Kharazi, a top foreign policy official and former Iranian foreign minister, has been severely injured in an airstrike on his home in Tehran earlier. His wife was reportedly killed in the attack. Kharazi, considered a moderate politician and veteran policy expert, also served as an adviser to the former supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was assassinated in the first hours of the US-Israeli war on Iran. As the BBC notes, this reported attack will raise questions about why Kharazi, head of the Strategic Council on Foreign Relations, was targeted in a system now increasingly dominated by hardliners. According to the New York Times, two Iranian officials said Kharazi had been overseeing engagement with Pakistan for a possible meeting between Iranian officials and US vice-president JD Vance.

chunk_b.text_snippet:
Title: New strikes hit Tehran – as it happened
Date: 2026-03-01

Content: Trump also used this room at Mar-a-Lago during the US operation to capture Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro last month. Over in the White House, vice-president JD Vance was in the actual Situation Room, monitoring the operation with senior US officials including energy secretary Chris Wright, director of national intelligence Tulsi Gabbard and treasury secretary Scott Bessent. Contradicting Israeli reports that Ali Khamenei is dead, Iran’s semi-official Tasnim and Mehr news agencies are reporting that the supreme leader is “steadfast and firm in commanding the field”. Again, we still haven’t had any official confirmation on Khamenei’s fate, and there is a strong incentive for both sides to control the narrative about him being dead or alive. We’ll bring you more clarity as we get it. The US president has been speaking to US media, in which he appears to back up Israeli reports that Iran’s supreme leader was killed in airstrikes today.

initial_question.rag_input: How did the reports regarding Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's fate change between the US-Israeli strikes on 01 March 2026 and the status of diplomatic engagement by 02 April 2026?
initial_question.question: How did the reports regarding Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's fate change between the US-Israeli strikes on 01 March 2026 and the status of diplomatic engagement by 02 April 2026?
initial_question.answer: On 01 March 2026, the status of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was contested; while US officials and Israeli reports claimed he was killed in airstrikes, Iranian state media insisted he remained in command. By 02 April 2026, subsequent reports confirmed that Ayatollah Ali Khamenei had been assassinated during the first hours of the US-Israeli war, which influenced the political landscape involving Kamal Kharazi, who had been overseeing diplomatic engagement for a potential meeting between Iranian officials and US vice-president JD Vance.
initial_question.bridging_topic: Evolution of Khamenei's status and US-Iran diplomatic channels
